Delivery.standard_sla: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 hours; standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
Delivery.tracking_protocol: Live shipment tracking is available via Carrier Integration using a valid Order ID.
Delivery.delay_threshold: Orders exceeding 5 business days without delivery trigger a courier inquiry.
Delivery.escalation_criteria: Shipments marked undelivered for >7 business days or confirmed lost by carrier are escalated for reshipment/refund.
Delivery.relevant_clause: Check the delivery policy and order-tracking information.

faqs.q: Why hasn't my order arrived yet?
faqs.a: Check the delivery policy and order-tracking information. Standard transit is 3-5 business days.

faqs.q: What if tracking shows no movement for 5 days?
faqs.a: Provide Order ID to initiate an expedited carrier trace.

Payment.standard_sla: Automated gateway settlement and reconciliation window is 24 to 48 hours.
Payment.tracking_protocol: Requires Bank Reference Number / Transaction UTR or Order ID for trace.
Payment.delay_threshold: If debit occurred without order confirmation past 48 hours, immediate reversal is logged.
Payment.escalation_criteria: Duplicate charges or unrecognized debits escalate to the Finance / Accounts department.
Payment.relevant_clause: Check the billing policy and payment gateway settlement timelines (24-48 hours).

faqs.q: Payment was deducted but order was not placed.
faqs.a: Payment gateways reconcile unassigned charges within 24-48 hours and auto-refund to source.

faqs.q: Charged twice for the same transaction.
faqs.a: Provide both transaction IDs for immediate finance team verification and reversal.

Product Defect.standard_sla: Defective, leaked, or damaged skincare products are replaced free of charge within 7 days of delivery.
Product Defect.tracking_protocol: Requires photographic evidence of defect, batch code, and package condition.
Product Defect.delay_threshold: Requests filed beyond 7 days of delivery require supervisory quality approval.
Product Defect.escalation_criteria: Skin reactions, seal tampering, or hazardous packaging escalate to Quality Assurance and Health Safety.
Product Defect.relevant_clause: Check the 7-day product return/replacement window and damage verification policy.

faqs.q: What should I do if the bottle arrived damaged or leaked?
faqs.a: Share photos of damaged item with Order ID within 7 days for a free immediate replacement.

Refund.standard_sla: Approved refunds process to original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Refund.tracking_protocol: Requires Return Pickup confirmation and warehouse quality inspection.
Refund.delay_threshold: Refunds pending past 7 business days require banking liaison escalation.
Refund.escalation_criteria: Discretionary refunds or refunds for non-returnable categories escalate to Support Manager.
Refund.relevant_clause: Check the refund policy, return status, and 5-7 business days settlement timeline.

faqs.q: How long does a refund take after order cancellation?
faqs.a: Once cancelled, payment is credited back within 5-7 business days depending on customer's bank.

Service.standard_sla: Customer grievances and service feedback are reviewed within 24 hours.
Service.tracking_protocol: Tracked via Helpdesk Ticket ID and customer account record.
Service.delay_threshold: Unanswered tickets past 24 hours receive priority elevation.
Service.escalation_criteria: Staff misconduct, severe dissatisfaction, or persistent unaddressed issues escalate to Senior Service Manager.
Service.relevant_clause: Check customer grievance handling guidelines and supervisory review policy.

faqs.q: How do I lodge a formal complaint about poor support?
faqs.a: Submit ticket number and summary for review by the customer relations supervisory panel.
